subject: Staff vetting & separation control ledger — SOC 2 evidence collection
messages:
From: ClearBridge Audit <audits@clearbridge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial evidence request — staff vetting and separation controls (SOC 2)

Hi Vivek and team,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of the upcoming SOC 2 readiness review, we need a focused bundle of evidence demonstrating employee onboarding, background screening, training completion, and offboarding controls for the rolling 12-month window ending 2026-05-01. Specifically we are asking for: 

- A CSV export of new hires (hire_date, role, location, background_check_status, screener_vendor-id) for 2025-05-01 -> 2026-05-01.
- A sample of background check reports (redacted) — provide filenames and mapping to employee IDs.
- Training completion index (security training, secure coding, role-based) with timestamps and version of training module.
- Offboarding records for all terminated/voluntary leavers during the window: deprovision checklist, last day, asset return attestations.
- Any process/runbook that shows who owns approvals and how contractor vs employee screening differs.

Please include an inventory manifest and identify any PII/PHI that needs redaction — we will accept redacted PDFs plus a CSV mapping to internal IDs. If possible, upload to the shared folder below or send via secure transfer. Our requested delivery date for the initial bundle is end-of-day 2026-06-04. If there are scope gaps (e.g., legacy contractors, data retention exceptions), flag them and propose mitigations.

Attached: evidence_checklist.csv (template).

Regards,
Elena V.
Senior Auditor
ClearBridge Audit

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: ClearBridge Audit <audits@clearbridge.com>, Elena V. <elena@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial evidence request — staff vetting and separation controls (SOC 2)

Elena — thanks, we received the checklist.

High-level plan (owners and milestones):
- Grace O'Connor (HR Ops) — run the hires export, produce background-check sample mapping (deliverable due: 2026-05-31).
- Monica Patel (Security & Controls) — compile training index and offboarding artefacts, perform redaction guidance (deliverable due: 2026-06-02).
- David Kim (IT Ops) — supply deprovisioning logs and asset return attestations (deliverable due: 2026-06-03).

Notes / clarifying Qs:
1) For background checks: we will provide redacted PDF samples plus a CSV mapping to internal employee IDs. Do you need full vendor reports or is an anonymized certificate suffcient for sampling?
2) Does the assessment require contractor screening records to the same depth as W-2 employees? We have different retention windows for contingent workers.
3) Preferred delivery: upload to the Drive link in the related_links list or to your secure intake portal (please confirm).

We'll target the dates above and flag any hold-ups early. Grace/Monica/David — please confirm and paste any blockers.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, ClearBridge Audit <audits@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial evidence request — staff vetting and separation controls (SOC 2)

Vivek / Elena — quick update from HR Ops.

On Fri, 28 May 2026 at 09:12, ClearBridge Audit <audits@clearbridge.com> wrote:
> As part of the upcoming SOC 2 readiness review, we need a focused bundle of evidence demonstrating employee onboarding, background screening, training completion, and offboarding controls...

What we can provide this week: 
- bg-sample-export-20260529.csv (attached) — contains hire_date, role, city, screening_vendor_id, screening_status. This is a sampled export (25% of hires across org levels). We will include a mapping file to internal IDs.
- training_completion_index_20260529.xlsx (attached) — includes training module version, completion timestamp, trainer id.
- onboarding-runbook-v3.pdf — internal runbook describing steps and owner sign-offs for new hires and contingent hires.

Redaction approach: we will remove SSNs and full DOBs from PDFs and replace with internal employee IDs. For background vendor packages that include scanned documents, we will provide vendor attestations where full redaction would break vendor TOS.

Exceptions to call out: several contractors engaged before 2024-09 were grandfathered into a simplified verification process; we will produce a list and propose attestations for those cases. Separately, there are three leavers (two voluntary, one termination) during the window with incomplete asset-return records — IT is working on supplemental attestations.

Next steps: I'll upload the attachments to the Drive link by EOD Monday (2026-06-01). Monica — I'll need your guidance on the offboarding attestations format.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
HR Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: ClearBridge Audit <audits@clearbridge.com>, Elena V. <elena@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial evidence request — staff vetting and separation controls (SOC 2)

Elena — delivering the initial bundle and a short delivery note. Links/attachments: 
- Uploaded to: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-onboarding-evidence (access granted to ClearBridge auditor account).
- Attachments included: bg-sample-export-20260529.csv, training_completion_index_20260529.xlsx, onboarding-runbook-v3.pdf, evidence_checklist.csv.
- IT logs: deprovision_events_202505-202605.csv (shared in Drive).

Summary of notable items: 
- Contractor retention policy: contingent worker verification is recorded in the runbook; contingent records prior to 2024-09 are flagged in the sample and require attestation (we included a proposed attestation template in the Drive).
- Incomplete asset returns: three cases flagged; David has supplied interim attestations and we will provide final receipts by 2026-06-08.
- PII redaction: vendor reports with sensitive scanned pages replaced with vendor attestations per vendor terms; mapped via bg-sample-export-20260529.csv.

Please review and confirm whether the provided artifacts satisfy the sampling needs or if you require additional unredacted items under NDA. If everything looks fine, would you confirm acceptance and next steps for the SIG/CAIQ-specific mapping?

Regards,
Monica Patel
Security & Controls Manager
Redwood Inference
